name: second-brain
description: One Git-native project knowledge system for Claude, Codex, and optional Obsidian. A managed operating manual, shared startup map, flat memory, visible provenance, project-scoped owner-approved saves, task-specific skills, read-only session search, and one checker.

interface.shortDescription: One Markdown project brain for agents and people.
interface.longDescription: Installs SOUL.md and one knowledge folder with a managed operating manual, project overview, short-term work state, flat long-term memory, approved specifications, two generated indexes, raw brainstorms, and minimal optional Obsidian settings. Claude and Codex load the same manual and small map. Task-specific skills follow that one policy for project-scoped saves, finding, lifecycle changes, review, setup, and read-only session history.
defaultPrompt: Set up project knowledge in this project
What has this project already decided about X?
Review what is saved for duplicates and contradictions
